facts.value: Provides the landing handoff for opened-Parasol descent reached after Parasol opening completes from a saved FallSpecial predecessor. It delegates collision handling with the basic LandingFallSpecial entry callback; that callback selects HammerLanding when its predicate passes and otherwise enters LandingFallSpecial. This is distinct from the retracted-Parasol FallSpecial phase.
facts.rationale: The saved-predecessor dispatch establishes which airborne phase reaches this family, while the collision wrapper and supplied callback establish the landing destinations without conflating reopening with retraction.

evidence.why: Completed opening from saved FallSpecial dispatches to this family's entry.
Collision wrapper supplies the basic special-landing callback.
Preserves the HammerLanding exception and normal LandingFallSpecial destination.
